input.claim: A Snapchain read node syncs the full mainnet history in under 6 hours.
input.receipt_excerpt: Our Snapchain read node finished a full sync of the testnet in 5h 20m on a 4-core VM. We have not yet run it against mainnet.

answer_key.note: Scope mismatch: receipt measures testnet, claim says mainnet. Shares read, node, Snapchain, sync, full, hours-ish tokens, fresh, independent author, so keyword/freshness/self-cite gates pass. The excerpt even says mainnet was not run.

input.claim: All 12 testers completed the Snapchain read node tutorial.
input.receipt_excerpt: Tutorial completion log for the Snapchain read node walkthrough: 9 of the 9 testers in the first cohort reached the final step and passed the sync check.

answer_key.note: Scope mismatch on population: 9 of 9 in the first cohort is a narrower population than all 12 testers. 'All ... completed' pattern-matches '9 of 9 completed', but the denominator differs and 3 testers are unaccounted for.
